risk_if_not_implemented: Without Implement Controls, security, compliance and resilience activities may lack direction, ownership and executive support, leaving required controls unperformed. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unperformed / Unowned Control Responsibilities (R-GV-3), Uncontrolled Internal Security / Privacy Exposure (R-GV-4), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Security, Compliance & Resilience In Project Management
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to assess security, compliance and resilience controls as part of Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) project development to determine whether controls are implemented correctly, operating as intended and producing the desired outcome with respect to meeting requirements.
compensating_control_1.justification: Security, Compliance & Resilience In Project Management (PRM-08) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Implement Controls (GOV-11.2) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Control Inheritance
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to define instances of control inheritance within assessment boundaries.
compensating_control_2.justification: Control Inheritance (CPL-15) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Implement Controls (GOV-11.2) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
